issues.description: Monkey-patching a private SDK attribute at import time will silently break on upgrade
issues.detail: genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024 reaches into a private module to fix a buffer-size problem. This is a global side effect at import, affects every consumer of google-genai in the process, and will vanish or crash when the underscore-prefixed attribute is renamed. File a real fix upstream or pass the buffer size through a documented API; do not ship a 'temporary hack' as a load-bearing import.

issues.description: image.tobytes() with format='RGB' will produce wrong pixels if PIL decodes as RGBA or P
issues.detail: Pillow opens PNGs in whatever mode the file declares. tobytes() returns raw bytes for that mode, but the frame is labeled format='RGB'. If the model returns RGBA (common for generated images) or palette mode, downstream code reads garbage. Convert explicitly: image = image.convert('RGB') before tobytes(). The data structure (image bytes + declared format) is fighting reality.

issues.description: Default model change is a silent behavior bump buried in a feature PR
issues.detail: Bumping the default from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash changes cost, latency, and output for every existing user who relied on the default. That belongs in its own PR with a migration note, not folded into an image-generation feature. The CHANGELOG entry exists but the coupling makes the diff harder to revert independently.

issues.description: Model-capability detection by substring match ('image' in model_name) is fragile
issues.detail: Detecting an image-generation model with `if 'image' in self._model_name` is a string-shape proxy for a real capability. Any future model with 'image' in its name (or without it) breaks the heuristic. The right data structure is a small capability table or a method like _is_image_model() with the known set; then the algorithm — skip thinking budget — is obvious.

issues.description: Image part handling silently drops alpha, dimensions metadata, and any error path
issues.detail: The new elif assumes inline_data.data is always a decodable image and pushes a single OutputImageRawFrame with no try/except, no logging, no MIME-type check. If the SDK ever returns a non-image inline_data (audio, video, partial bytes), PIL raises and the whole context loop dies. A small guard plus mime_type inspection on part.inline_data would be more honest about the data shape.

issues.description: Stray blank line and inline import suggest the patch grew organically rather than by design
issues.detail: The added empty line after self._http_options and the implicit reliance on io and PIL.Image being imported elsewhere in the module are small smells. Not load-bearing, but they hint that image handling was bolted onto _process_context rather than extracted into a small _handle_inline_data(part) helper. Composition over inlining: a four-line filter function would make the intent obvious.

review.summary: The feature is small and the diff is mostly honest, but two real problems hide inside it: a global monkey-patch of a private google-genai attribute at module import (READ_BUFFER_SIZE), and an image-handling path that labels bytes as RGB without converting the PIL image. Both will fail quietly in production. Secondary concerns: the default-model bump is piggybacked on the feature, and capability detection uses substring matching where a tiny data structure would make the rule obvious. Strip the hack, convert the image, separate the default change, and the rest is fine.
